experiences.name: Hoan Kiem Lake & Old Quarter Street Food Walk
experiences.description: Explore Hanoi's iconic Old Quarter on foot, sampling iconic street foods like Bun Cha, Banh Mi, and Egg Coffee from vendors and tiny plastic-stool eateries clustered around Hoan Kiem Lake. Stay in a hostel within the Old Quarter itself to walk to every stall.
experiences.location: Old Quarter, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi

experiences.name: Hoi An Ancient Town Lantern Festival & Local Cuisine
experiences.description: Wander the UNESCO-listed Ancient Town of Hoi An during the monthly Lantern Festival, tasting White Rose Dumplings, Cao Lau noodles, and Banh Mi Phuong. Book a hostel on Tran Hung Dao Street inside the Ancient Town to be steps away from all activity.
experiences.location: Ancient Town, Hoi An, Quang Nam Province

experiences.name: Motorbike Street Food Tour of Ho Chi Minh City
experiences.description: Join a budget-friendly local-led motorbike tour through District 1 and District 3, stopping at hidden alley kitchens for Banh Xeo, Hu Tieu, and fresh spring rolls. Choose a hostel in District 1 on Pham Ngu Lao Street to be at the heart of the tour departure points.
experiences.location: Pham Ngu Lao Backpacker Street, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City

experiences.name: Hue Imperial Citadel & Royal Cuisine Tasting
experiences.description: Explore the historic Imperial Citadel and royal tombs of the Nguyen Dynasty, then sample Hue's distinctive royal cuisine including Bun Bo Hue and Banh Khoai at street stalls just outside the citadel walls. Stay in a guesthouse on Hung Vuong Street near the citadel entrance for easy access.
experiences.location: Imperial Citadel Area, Hue City, Thua Thien Hue Province

experiences.name: Ninh Binh Bicycle Tour through Tam Coc Rice Paddies
experiences.description: Rent a bicycle from your guesthouse in Tam Coc village and pedal through breathtaking limestone karst landscapes and emerald rice paddies, stopping at local roadside stalls for Com Chay (crispy rice) and fresh goat meat — a Ninh Binh specialty. Staying in Tam Coc village puts you directly at the trailhead.
experiences.location: Tam Coc Village, Ninh Binh Province
